docs.title: Life Systems Manual
docs.text:
This site is a collection of simple, practical systems designed to make everyday life easier to manage.

The goal is not complexity, but clarity—clear steps, clear structure, and repeatable processes that remove guesswork from important areas like money, work, and personal growth.

Core Areas Money System — Manage income, savings, and taxes with structure Technology — Build and understand real-world systems Personal Systems — Stay consistent and focused How to Use This

Start with one system, follow it step-by-step, and build consistency over time. Each section is designed to stand on its own but work together as part of a larger framework.

docs.title: Local AI Access
docs.text:
System Component: Local Device AI Environment

Purpose: Provide a private, portable artificial intelligence assistant that runs directly on the user's device without requiring access to the central AI server.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
"How do I use AI anywhere?"

The Local AI environment is the lightweight side of the dual-mode AI architecture.

Instead of depending entirely on a remote server or cloud-based service, the user's device can run a smaller AI model directly from their device.

This provides:

  • Portable AI Assistant

    AI access directly from the iPad.

    Available for:

    • Questions
    • Writing
    • Notes
    • Brainstorming
    • Planning

  • Private Processing

    Information remains on the local device.

    No external AI provider is required.

  • Offline Capability

    Useful when:

    • Internet is unavailable
    • Traveling
    • Working remotely
    • Accessing private information

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The Local AI system exists to provide a fast, simple assistant for everyday tasks.

It is designed around convenience and privacy.

Common uses include:

  • Drafting emails
  • Creating notes
  • Organizing ideas
  • Summarizing information
  • Creating checklists
  • Brainstorming solutions
  • Answering general questions
  • Personal productivity

Info

Local AI is the everyday assistant.

The remote AI server handles heavier workloads requiring more processing power, storage, and memory.

Project Type: Private, locally hosted artificial intelligence environment

Purpose: Create a personal AI assistant that combines intelligence, memory, and documentation into one private knowledge system.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The goal of this project is to create a personal, locally hosted artificial intelligence system that functions as:

  • Personal Assistant

    Helps with:

    • Questions
    • Writing
    • Planning
    • Daily tasks

  • Knowledge Manager

    Organizes:

    • Documents
    • Notes
    • Projects
    • Personal records

  • Automation Platform

    Supports:

    • Workflows
    • Business processes
    • Document processing
    • Repetitive tasks

Unlike traditional cloud-based AI services, this system is designed around:

  • Self-hosted AI models
  • Local storage
  • Personal infrastructure
  • Custom workflows
  • User-controlled data

Info

This project is not about creating another chatbot.

The goal is to create a private AI environment that understands the user's information, projects, and workflows.

docs.title: Privacy and Data Ownership
docs.text:
A locally hosted AI system keeps information under the user's control.

Personal documents, business records, receipts, notes, and project files can be processed without requiring outside services.

Important use cases include:

  • Private Documents

    Personal records, notes, and documentation.

  • Financial Information

    Receipts, expenses, and business records.

  • Private Projects

    Engineering work, designs, and family systems.

The user controls:

  • Where data is stored
  • How it is accessed
  • How backups are created
  • How the system evolves

docs.title: Customization
docs.text:
Cloud AI systems are designed for general users.

A local AI system can be designed around a specific environment.

The AI can be trained through access to:

  • Personal documentation
  • Project knowledge
  • Business procedures
  • Technical references
  • Preferred workflows
  • Custom tools

Example

A general AI knows how to answer questions.

A personal AI knows how you organize information, document projects, and complete tasks.

docs.title: Reliability and Independence
docs.text:
A locally hosted system reduces dependence on external services.

The system can continue operating even when:

  • Internet access is unavailable
  • Subscription costs increase
  • External services change
  • Data policies change

The infrastructure, models, and knowledge base remain controlled by the user.

docs.title: The Role of Memory
docs.text:
A traditional chatbot only understands the current conversation.

Once the conversation ends, information is lost unless manually saved.

This system approaches memory differently.

Instead of forcing the AI model itself to remember everything, memory is built as a separate layer.

docs.text:

Benefits:

  • Better Memory

    Long-term knowledge retention.

  • Efficiency

    Reduced token usage and faster responses.

  • Organization

    Structured access to stored information.

  • Accuracy

    Responses based on relevant stored information.

docs.title: Long-Term Vision
docs.text:
Quote

The goal is not simply to create a stronger chatbot.

The goal is to create a personal information system where artificial intelligence becomes the interface between the user and their own knowledge.

The system is built from three parts:

  • Intelligence

    The AI model provides reasoning and communication.

  • Experience

    The memory system provides access to accumulated information.

  • Structure

    Documentation provides organization and context.

Together, these components create a private AI assistant that grows alongside the user's:

  • Projects
  • Responsibilities
  • Business
  • Knowledge
  • Workflows

The AI does not replace the user's information system.

It becomes the interface for interacting with it.

docs.title: Remote AI Access
docs.text:
System Component: Remote AI Server Environment

Purpose: Provide a powerful, private AI processing environment accessible securely from user devices through an encrypted network.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
"How does the AI infrastructure work?"

The Remote AI environment is the primary intelligence layer of the system.

Unlike the lightweight Local AI model running on the iPad, the remote server is designed for:

  • High Performance AI

    Runs larger AI models using dedicated hardware.

    Designed for:

    • Complex reasoning
    • Large documents
    • Extended conversations
    • Advanced workflows

  • Long-Term Knowledge

    Stores and retrieves information using:

    • Documents
    • Notes
    • Projects
    • Receipts
    • Knowledge databases

  • Automation Platform

    Provides infrastructure for:

    • Business workflows
    • Document processing
    • AI agents
    • Future integrations

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The Remote AI server acts as the central intelligence engine.

The user's devices connect to the server securely instead of sending information to external AI providers.

The server provides:

  • Larger AI models
  • Increased processing power
  • Persistent storage
  • Memory systems
  • Document indexing
  • Automation capabilities

Info

The iPad is the interface.

The server is the intelligence layer.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
This system was created to provide a clear and practical way to manage money without relying on complicated budgeting methods or constant decision-making.

It is built on real-world use—simple enough to follow consistently, but structured enough to prevent common financial mistakes. The focus is on control, not restriction; on understanding, not guesswork.

While the system is straightforward, its impact comes from discipline and repetition. When applied consistently, it creates stability, reduces financial stress, and allows you to focus on building toward the future instead of reacting to problems.

The goal is not just to manage money, but to create a system that works reliably over time.

docs.title: PURPOSE:
docs.text: Protect yourself from unexpected expenses without going into debt.

docs.title: CORE IDEA:
docs.text: Life will break things—your car, your plans, or your income. The emergency fund absorbs that impact.

docs.title: WHAT IT COVERS:
docs.text:
1. Car repairs
  2. Medical expenses
  3. Job loss or reduced income
  4. Urgent, unplanned costs

docs.title: HOW TO BUILD IT:
docs.text:
1. Start small:
    • First goal: $500–$1,000
  2. Grow over time:
    • Target: 3–6 months of expenses
  3. Keep it separate:
    • Stored in a savings account (not checking)

docs.title: WHY THIS WORKS:
docs.text:
• Prevents credit card debt
  • Reduces stress during emergencies
  • Keeps your system stable

docs.title: KEY RULES:
docs.text:
1. Only use for true emergencies
  2. Refill it after using it
  3. Do not invest this money

docs.title: RESULT:
docs.text: You stay in control even when things go wrong.

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Managing money doesn’t have to be complicated, but it does require structure. Most financial stress comes from not knowing where money is going or what it needs to do next.

This system is designed to remove that uncertainty. By giving every dollar a clear purpose from the moment it’s received, you create a simple, repeatable process that keeps you in control.

The goal isn’t perfection—it’s consistency. Small, disciplined actions taken over time lead to stability, confidence, and long-term growth.

docs.title: PURPOSE:
docs.text: Grow money over time instead of just storing it.

docs.title: CORE IDEA:
docs.text: Money that sits still loses value. Money that is invested has the potential to grow.

docs.title: HOW IT WORKS:
docs.text:
1. Set aside a portion of income:
    • After spending, saving, and taxes
  2. Invest consistently:
    • Regular contributions over time
  3. Let time do the work:
    • Growth compounds year after year

docs.title: TYPES OF ACCOUNTS:
docs.text:
1. Roth IRA

    • Tax-free growth
    • Long-term use

  2. Brokerage Account

    • Flexible access
    • No age restrictions

docs.title: KEY CONCEPT: COMPOUNDING
docs.text: Money earns → then earns on what it earned

docs.title: WHY THIS WORKS:
docs.text:
• Builds long-term wealth
  • Outpaces inflation
  • Reduces reliance on income alone

docs.title: KEY RULES:
docs.text:
1. Invest for the long term
  2. Do not panic during market drops
  3. Stay consistent over time

docs.title: RESULT:
docs.text: Your money works for you instead of you working for it forever.

docs.title: The 4-account money system
docs.text:
The 4-account money system is a simple way to manage income by separating it into clear, purpose-driven categories. Instead of keeping all money in one place, each dollar is assigned a job as soon as it comes in.

The system consists of four core accounts:

Spending (Checking): Used for everyday expenses like bills, food, and personal purchases. Taxes (High-Yield Savings): A dedicated account where a percentage of income (typically 25–30%) is set aside to cover future tax obligations. Savings (Emergency Fund): Reserved for unexpected expenses such as car repairs, medical costs, or temporary loss of income. Investing (Wealth Building): Long-term funds placed into accounts like a Roth IRA or brokerage account to grow over time.

By splitting income immediately upon receiving it, this system removes guesswork, prevents overspending, and ensures that taxes, emergencies, and future growth are consistently accounted for. It creates structure, discipline, and financial clarity without requiring complex budgeting.

docs.title: Using the System to Pay Taxes Efficiently
docs.text:
One of the biggest advantages of the 4-account system is how it simplifies paying taxes. By consistently setting aside a percentage of income (typically 25–30%) into a dedicated tax account, you avoid the stress of scrambling for money at the end of the year.

When this tax account is a high-yield savings account, it does more than just hold money—it earns interest over time. As your income is deposited and your tax portion is set aside, the balance gradually grows. The bank pays you interest for holding that money, effectively generating a small return on funds that you would have owed anyway.

By the end of the year, you have:

The full amount needed to pay your taxes Additional money earned from interest

This means your tax obligation is fully covered, and the interest earned either offsets part of the tax burden or becomes extra money you keep. Instead of taxes feeling like a sudden loss, the system turns it into a controlled, predictable process that even works slightly in your favor.

The key is consistency—setting aside money immediately when income is received and leaving it untouched until taxes are due.

docs.title: PURPOSE:
docs.text: Create a predictable, stress-free way to handle taxes.

docs.title: CORE IDEA:
docs.text: Taxes should never be a surprise. The money is set aside as income is earned, not when the bill arrives.

docs.title: HOW IT WORKS:
docs.text:
1. Every time income is received:
    • Move ~25–30% into your Tax Account (HYSA)
  2. Let the money sit:
    • Earn interest over time
    • Do not touch it
  3. When taxes are due:
    • Pay directly from the tax account

docs.title: WHY THIS WORKS:
docs.text:
• Removes panic at the end of the year
  • Prevents overspending money that isn’t yours
  • Earns small returns on money you already owe

docs.title: KEY RULES:
docs.text:
1. Set aside money immediately
  2. Never spend from the tax account
  3. Always assume you owe taxes

docs.title: RESULT:
docs.text: Taxes become routine instead of stressful.

docs.title: ▶️ Startup Procedure
docs.text: Follow these steps in order each time the pool is started after maintenance, seasonal opening, or an extended shutdown.

docs.title: 📋 Before You Begin
docs.text:
What You'll Need

  • Pool filled to the proper water level
  • All hoses connected securely
  • Electrical power available (120V GFCI)
  • Sand filter assembled and ready
  • QS1200 Saltwater System connected
  • System Diagram available for reference if needed

docs.title: Step 1 — Inspect the Pool
docs.text:
Inspect Before Starting

Verify the following before turning anything on:

  • Pool water is at the proper level.
  • No hoses are kinked or pinched.
  • Hose clamps are tight.
  • Return fitting is securely installed.
  • Skimmer/intake is free of debris.
  • Equipment appears clean and undamaged.

docs.title: Step 2 — Verify Valve Positions
docs.text:
Check Valves

Confirm the following:

  • Suction valves are OPEN.
  • Multiport valve is set to FILTER.
  • Air relief valve is closed (unless priming the system).

docs.title: Step 3 — Prime the Pump
docs.text:
Remove Air From the System

If the pump has lost prime:

  1. Fill the pump basket with water.
  2. Open the air relief valve.
  3. Allow trapped air to escape.
  4. Close the valve once water flows steadily.
  5. Ensure the pump basket is completely full before continuing.

docs.title: Step 4 — Start the Pump
docs.text:
Begin Water Circulation

Turn the pump ON.

Verify:

  • Water begins circulating.
  • Pump sounds smooth and normal.
  • No excessive air bubbles are visible.
  • No leaks appear around hoses or fittings.

docs.title: Step 5 — Verify Sand Filter Operation
docs.text:
Check the Filter

Confirm:

  • Strong return flow into the pool.
  • No water leaking around fittings.
  • Filter pressure appears normal.
  • Water is circulating continuously.

docs.title: Step 6 — Enable the QS1200 Saltwater System
docs.text:
Start Chlorine Generation

After normal water circulation has been established:

  • Turn ON the QS1200.
  • Verify normal indicator lights.
  • Confirm there are no warning or error lights.
  • Verify water is flowing in the correct direction through the unit.

docs.title: Step 7 — Final Inspection
docs.text:
Startup Complete

Confirm all of the following:

  • ✅ Pump running smoothly
  • ✅ Strong return flow
  • ✅ No water leaks
  • ✅ No trapped air
  • ✅ QS1200 operating normally
  • ✅ Pool ready for normal operation

docs.title: Common Startup Problems
docs.text:
💧 Pump runs, but no water is moving

Check these items in order:

  • Verify pool water level.
  • Ensure both suction valves are open.
  • Prime the pump again.
  • Check hoses for kinks.
  • Inspect intake screens for blockages.
🔊 Pump is noisy

Common causes:

  • Air trapped in the plumbing.
  • Low water level.
  • Loose suction-side fitting.
  • Pump not fully primed.
🌊 Weak or No Return Flow

Possible causes:

  • Dirty sand filter.
  • Pump not primed.
  • Closed valve.
  • Blocked hose.
  • Dirty skimmer basket.
🧂 QS1200 Will Not Start

Verify:

  • Pump is circulating water.
  • Salt level is within specification.
  • Power is connected.
  • Water is flowing in the correct direction.
  • No warning lights are displayed.

docs.title: ⏱️ Expected Startup Timeline
docs.text:
Normal Startup Timing

Approximate startup times:

Pump starts: Immediately

Water reaches the return jet: 30–60 seconds

Air clears from the system: 1–2 minutes

QS1200: Turn ON only after steady water flow has been established.

docs.title: 💡 Startup Tips
docs.text:
Helpful Reminders
  • Follow the steps in order.
  • Don't rush the priming process.
  • Listen for unusual pump noises.
  • Watch for leaks during the first few minutes.
  • If something doesn't look right, stop and inspect before continuing.
  • Most startup issues are caused by trapped air, low water level, or closed valves.

docs.title: 🚀 Startup Complete
docs.text:
Once all checks have passed, the system should be operating normally.

If a problem develops after startup:

  • 🗺️ Review the System Diagram
  • ⚠️ Open the Troubleshooting guide
  • 🧹 Continue to Maintenance
  • 📦 Check the Parts Reference

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
🕐 Five Minute Rule

Spend five minutes checking the simple things first.

  • Is there power?
  • Is there water?
  • Are the valves open?
  • Are the hoses connected?
  • Is the filter clean?

Most problems are solved here.

START --> POWER{Pump has power?}

POWER -- No --> BREAKER["Check breaker
Check GFCI
Check timer"]

POWER -- Yes --> PRIME{Pump primed?}

PRIME -- No --> AIR["Open air valve
Fill pump basket
Remove trapped air"]

PRIME -- Yes --> FLOW{Water flowing?}

FLOW -- No --> BLOCKAGE["Inspect:

• Suction hoses
• T-valve
• Skimmer
• Pump basket"]

FLOW -- Yes --> SALT{E.C.O. running?}

SALT -- No --> CHECKFLOW["Verify flow sensor
Verify arrows
Check salt level"]

SALT -- Yes --> GOOD([System Operating Normally])

docs.text:
• 🛑 Pump won't start
  • 💧 Pump runs, but no water moves
  • 🌊 Weak water flow
  • 🧂 Salt system warning
  • 💨 Air bubbles
  • 🔄 Need to backwash

✅ What Normal Looks Like

If everything is working correctly, you should see:

  • Strong water flow from the return jet.
  • Pump running smoothly without unusual noises.
  • No continuous stream of air bubbles.
  • QS1200 operating normally.
  • Water level approximately halfway up the skimmer opening.
🛑 Pump won't start 💧 Pump runs but no water is moving

Follow these steps in order:

  1. Verify the pool water level.
  2. Make sure both suction valves are open.
  3. Open the air relief valve to remove trapped air.
  4. Check for clogged intake screens.
  5. Inspect hoses for kinks.
  6. Verify the pump basket is full of water (primed).

Tip

Most circulation problems are caused by trapped air or low water level.

🌊 Water flow is weak

Possible causes:

  • Dirty sand filter
  • Full pump basket
  • Low water level
  • Air leak on suction side
  • Clogged intake
🧂 QS1200 Salt System isn't producing chlorine

Verify:

  • Pump is running.
  • Water is flowing normally.
  • Salt level is within specification.
  • Cell is clean.
  • Water is flowing in the correct direction through the unit.

Info

The QS1200 should always be installed after the sand filter.

🔄 Need to Backwash?

Perform a backwash if:

  • Water flow has noticeably decreased.
  • Filter pressure has increased.
  • Water appears dirty after normal operation.
💨 Air bubbles coming back into the pool

Small bubbles during startup are normal.

Constant bubbles usually indicate:

  • Loose hose clamp
  • Loose pump lid
  • Cracked hose
  • Air leak on the suction side

Tip

Air leaks happen before the pump.

Water leaks usually happen after the pump.

That's a quick way to narrow down where to look.

🚫 Never Do These
  • Never run the pump without water.
  • Never run the QS1200 without water flow.
  • Never change the multiport valve while the pump is running.
  • Never operate with closed suction valves.
  • Never disconnect hoses while the system is pressurized.
❓Still Not Working?

Follow this order:

  1. Stop the pump.
  2. Open the System Diagram page.
  3. Verify every hose follows the arrows.
  4. Check every valve position.
  5. Restart using the Startup page.
  6. If it still doesn't work, begin troubleshooting again from the top.

Success

Don't skip around.

Start at the beginning and work one step at a time.

docs.title: Check these first
docs.text:
• GFCI outlet has not tripped.
  • Circuit breaker is ON.
  • Timer (if installed) is ON.
  • Power cord is securely plugged in.
  • Reset button has been pressed.

Motor hums but won't spin

Turn the pump OFF immediately.

Continuing to run the pump can damage the motor.

docs.title: Recommended Action
docs.text:
Start with the easiest checks:

  1. Empty the basket.
  2. Check the water level.
  3. Backwash the filter if needed.

docs.title: Backwash Procedure
docs.text:
1. Turn pump OFF.
  2. Rotate valve to BACKWASH.
  3. Run for about 2 minutes.
  4. Turn OFF.
  5. Rotate to RINSE.
  6. Run for 30 seconds.
  7. Return valve to FILTER.
  8. Restart pump.
